office_does: A Kitsap County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; the county's four district judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Kevin P Kelly, on the bench since a 2017 appointment, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Kitsap County District Court judge since a 2017 appointment; previously a county deputy prosecutor for 27 years. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed in 2017; elected unopposed in 2018 and 2022 [S1][S2][S3]
Deputy prosecutor for 27 years, including chief deputy of the District/Municipal Court Division [S1]
Helped create the county's Veterans Treatment Court and Behavioral Health Court as a prosecutor [S1]
